description.value: Alderlea Farm and Cafe is a multi-generational biodynamic family farm in the Cowichan Valley that has been running a wood-fired, farm-to-table restaurant for seventeen years, growing much of the food served on-site. The café is now helmed by the second generation of the founding family and features an expanded outdoor dining area, making it a genuine destination meal stop in the Cowichan Valley. Beyond the café, the farm also offers CSA harvest boxes and year-round farm stays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active farm-to-table restaurant and working biodynamic farm in Duncan, BC, open Friday through Sunday, with a full menu including wood-fired pizzas and burgers. The address (3390 Glenora Road, Duncan, BC V9L 6S1) and website URL match OSM exactly. The menu explicitly lists veggie burgers and gluten/dairy-free pizza options, confirming vegetarian and GF availability; no bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned on the website, so those remain null despite OSM's internet_access=yes tag.
concerns: OSM name uses 'and' ('Alderlea Farm and Cafe') but the website consistently uses an ampersand ('Alderlea Farm & Cafe') — may warrant an OSM correction.
OSM record has no phone number; café phone (250) 597-3438 sourced from website only.
OSM internet_access=yes tag could not be corroborated by website content; Wi-Fi left as null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating farm-to-table café and biodynamic farm in the Cowichan Valley, clearly open and publicly accessible — a strong destination stop for touring cyclists in the region.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists veggie burgers alongside grass-fed beef burgers; gluten-free and dairy-free pizza is available on request ('Make any pizza gluten or dairy free for an additional cost'). Vegetarian pizza options also present (Spinach Delight, The Forager, Margarita)
